Source: https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills/tree/2686b620fc1fed2e8f60c704839c766b8594c6b6/skills/using-agent-skills

Firefly preserves its existing ID, frontmatter, mode and tool permissions. This discovery workflow is rewritten as a Firefly-maintained host adaptation: exact registered ID mapping, bounded existing meta-tool reads, optional approved task delegation and explicit unavailable-workflow handling. It is not an unmodified upstream distribution.
